listing_info.listing_name: Sandpiper Cove 2115
listing_info.description:
SANDPIPER COVE 2115

The space
FREE FUN INCLUDED EVERY DAY! Destin Pointe Vacation Rentals is one of the ONLY management companies to provide over $800 of FREE activities every day of your stay at some of the most popular attractions the emerald coast has to offer – including dolphin cruises, tiki cruises, party boat fishing, golf, Big Kahuna’s water park, the Gulfarium Marine Adventure park, Urban Air Adventure Park, and more! In addition to our FREE activities and rentals, we also offer many optional activities to book through our Activity Concierge.
*Subject to seasonal availability
(ONE free admission per activity/per day)

This beautiful and renovated second story four-bedroom, three-bathroom condo sits directly on the Gulf, offering stunning views of the Emerald Coast and 1,100 feet of private white sandy beaches. Enjoy the Destin lifestyle in comfort and luxury, with floor-to-ceiling windows offering spectacular views.
The condo is equipped with a full kitchen that includes modern stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and all the necessary cookware and utensils needed to prepare delicious meals during your stay. The dining area provides seating for four guests; additional seating is available at the kitchen island.
The master bedroom features a comfortable king-size bed, a flat-screen TV, an entrance to the private balcony, and an en suite bathroom featuring a walk-in shower and double vanity. The second bedroom also features a king-size bed, a flat-screen TV, an entrance to the private balcony, and an en-suite bathroom. The third bedroom has two full-size beds and access to the private balcony. And the fourth bathroom has a twin-over-twin bunk bed and an additional twin trundle bed.
At the center of Sandpiper Cove sits Louisiana Lagniappe, one of Destin’s most sought-after restaurants. You will also find Rick’s Sand Trap Bar and Grill on the Gulf side. As a guest of this condo, you can enjoy one of the five sparkling swimming pools and three hot tubs or practice your backhand swing on one of the six tennis courts. After spending a day enjoying the beach or lounging poolside, grab your clubs and play a friendly game of golf on the 9-hole three par course. You will also have access to beach service, which includes two chairs and an umbrella set up each day on the beach.
Your ultimate beachfront vacation begins here at Sandpiper Cove unit 2115.
*Sandpiper Cove 2115 is professionally managed by Destin Pointe Realty and is best rented and priced directly through our website.

INCLUDED IN YOUR STAY:
Free parking at the Harbor Walk Village (with arm band)
Kitchen stocked with essential cookware
Quality bath, kitchen, and laundry amenities
Iron or steamer
Bed linens
Washer/dryer
High speed Wi-Fi

Charcoal grills located near each pool
Private beach

24/7 customer support

Damage waiver fee is included in the total cost of the rental

Guest access
Guests staying at Sandpiper Cove in Destin, FL, will enjoy a variety of fantastic amenities just steps away from the beautiful Gulf of Mexico. The resort features private beach access, five heated swimming pools, and hot tubs for ultimate relaxation. Guests can also take advantage of the on-site restaurant, a nine-hole golf course, tennis courts, and a marina with boat slips available. With a prime location near top dining and shopping, Sandpiper Cove offers a perfect blend of fun and comfort for every guest.

listing_info.listing_name: Tropical Beachfront Condo w/ Great Views in Destin
listing_info.description:
Welcome to Silver Beach Towers West 1606, a bright coastal modern four-bedroom, three-bathroom beachfront condo on the 16th floor. Step onto the spacious beachfront balcony to enjoy the sea breeze and endless shoreline views.

The space
This corner retreat features an open-concept living area filled with natural light from floor-to-ceiling windows, and a comfortable seating space around a large flat-screen TV. A beautiful fully equipped kitchen features stainless steel appliances, sleek countertops, and everything you need to prepare meals together. A sleek dining table seats six guests with additional seating for four at the breakfast bar. Completing the space is a wet bar with wine fridge and ice maker. The primary suite offers a king bed, walk-in closet, balcony access, floor to ceiling windows with stunning gulf views. An en-suite bathroom features a double vanity and large walk-in shower. The first guest bedroom includes two queen beds and flat-screen TV, and an attached bathroom with a walk-in shower. The second and third guest bedrooms feature king beds, and flat-screen TVs, sleeping up to 10 guests comfortably. A north facing balcony is accessible from all guest bedrooms overlooking the greater Destin area. For added convenience, this condo offers an additional bathroom with a tub/shower combo, complimentary Wi-Fi and an in-unit washer and dryer. With its stunning views and comfortable layout, Silver Beach Towers West 1606 is the perfect choice for your next Destin beach vacation.

Silver Beach Towers provides beach service set-ups (2 chairs, 1 umbrella) for a fee through a third party from March 1 - October 31. The first set-up for guests of this condo is available for a discounted rate of $30 per day, and additional set-ups can be reserved at $65 per day. Beach service reservations can be made once your Compass Resorts reservation is confirmed, and detailed instructions will be sent to you.

BEDDING SUMMARY
Primary Bedroom: King Bed
Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds
Guest Bedroom: King Bed
Guest Bedroom: King Bed

Escape to luxury at Silver Beach Towers in Destin, Florida, a premier beachfront resort where paradise meets comfort. Located directly on the sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast, Silver Beach Towers offers everything you need for the ultimate Destin beach vacation. Relax by one of two beachfront pools, with the East Pool seasonally heated, soak in the hot tubs, or enjoy a game on the private tennis courts, all surrounded by beautifully landscaped grounds. Guests also have direct access to the beach via stairs with convenient beach service just steps away (no access to a ramp). Tip-Sea Turtle brings even more convenience to your stay by offering quick bites or refreshing drinks seasonally while enjoying the crystal-clear waters and crashing waves of Destin’s shoreline. With spacious luxury vacation rentals, a family-friendly atmosphere, and endless activities nearby, including shopping, dining, golf, and entertainment, Silver Beach Towers is the perfect choice for your next Destin getaway. Book your stay today and discover why Silver Beach Towers is one of the top Destin beachfront resorts.

This professionally managed Destin vacation rental is brought to you by Compass Resorts, a locally owned and operated company dedicated to delivering consistent, exceptional quality. Your vacation is our priority, and we strive to exceed your expectations every step of the way. To ensure convenience and comfort, we provide a welcome kit of essential amenities such as trash can liners, small dishwasher detergent, dish soap, dish sponge, a roll of paper towels, laundry detergent, bathroom paper, and facial soap for our guests. Guests will also receive a complimentary SOJO amenity kit with shampoo, conditioner, and body wash in Compass’s own signature scent. For longer stays, we recommend purchasing additional supplies to meet your specific needs.

Other things to note
-Must be 25 to rent, and the party must be at a ratio of no more than two people for each parent or guardian over the age of 25.
- All occupants are included in occupancy counts, regardless of age.
-As of 5/18/2020, smoking or vaping is prohibited in all common areas at Silver Beach Towers, including balconies and patios. The association has the authority to enforce this rule as smoke can be a nuisance to others. Smokers should avoid smoking on balconies or patios if it bothers neighbors. The first violation will result in a friendly reminder. A second or subsequent violation will incur a $50 fine per occurrence. Continued non-compliance may lead to eviction for renters and liens or litigation for owners.

listing_info.listing_name: Happy Days at Destin Pointe Resort
listing_info.description:
HAPPY DAYS AT DESTIN POINTE RESORT

The space
Welcome to "Happy Days" - where every day feels like a sun-kissed celebration! This beautiful beach house is nestled within the picturesque Destin Pointe Community on Holiday and comes equipped with everything you need for family fun, including 2 stand-up paddle boards, 2 kayaks, 6 surfboards that can double as boogie boards, a ping pong table, and a corn hole set. It's the perfect getaway for creating unforgettable memories.

The home boasts a spacious layout, ideal for families or groups seeking comfort and convenience. Each of the four bedrooms offers a tranquil retreat, while the three bathrooms ensure ample space for all. The primary bedroom features a luxurious king-size bed, offering a plush retreat for ultimate relaxation. Among the remaining three bedrooms, one has a king-size bed, one boasts a comfortable queen-size bed, while the third provides versatile sleeping arrangements with a twin over queen bunk bed with a twin trundle bed, perfect for accommodating various guest preferences and needs.

Located just steps away from the boardwalk stretching over the serene Lake Christina and leading to the pristine Gulf Beach, adventure awaits at every turn. Enjoy leisurely strolls or bike rides past three of the community's sparkling pools with four adult bikes provided for exploration.

For beach enthusiasts, two convenient access points and seasonal beach service promise endless days of sun, sand, and surf. Meanwhile, sports enthusiasts can indulge in friendly matches at the onsite tennis and pickleball courts, followed by a rejuvenating workout at the fitness center conveniently located within the rental office.

This charming coastal retreat isn't just a vacation rental; it's a promise of endless smiles, carefree moments, and memories that will make you glow long after the sun sets. So, kick off your shoes, feel the sand between your toes, and let the good times roll at Happy Days - because here, happiness is always in season!
**Happy Days is professionally managed by Destin Pointe Realty.

RESORT-STYLE AMENITIES

✦ Private beach access to the Emerald Coast
✦ Boat shuttle service to HarborWalk Village
✦ Three resort pools, including a gulf-front infinity-edge pool, heated pool, hot tub, and children’s splash pad
✦ Two Recently refinished pickleball courts and one tennis court.
✦ Onsite Fitness center
✦ Complimentary adult bicycles
✦ Shuffleboard
✦ Gas grilling stations
✦ Scenic boardwalks surrounding Lake Christina

SEASONAL HIGHLIGHTS

✦ Beach service (March–October) with two chairs and one umbrella on the Gulf-side beach

GOOD TO KNOW

✦ Primary renter must be 25+
✦ Pet-free environment for guest comfort
✦ Seasonal tram service is no longer available

Guest access
Guests have full private access to the entire home, including all bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen, living areas, and in-unit amenities.

Guests staying in the gated community of Destin Pointe enjoy a wide range of amenities for fun and relaxation. Take advantage of two private beach access points, including one with beach service, or cool off in three sparkling community pools, including the newest infinity pool overlooking the Gulf-side beach. Stay active with tennis and pickleball courts, a fully equipped fitness center, and four complimentary adult bikes. Beautifully landscaped grounds feature scenic walking paths, tranquil lakes, and charming picnic areas—perfect for a leisurely vacation.

listing_info.listing_name: Palmetto Cottage at Destin Pointe Resort
listing_info.description:
PALMETTO COTTAGE AT DESTIN POINTE RESORT

The space
This recently renovated home with a one-minute walk to the beach is located in the private and prestigious neighborhood of Destin Pointe. Come experience a coastal getaway like no other and enjoy stunning Gulf and East Point views and sunsets from any of the three expansive and furnished decks.

Spread out in any of our four cozy bedrooms, each including private outdoor spaces and baths. (except for the bunk room). The primary suite features a king bed, walk-in closet, a private bathroom, and a large walk-in shower with double vanity. The second and third bedrooms feature king and double beds, both with smart TVs, generous closet space, and private decks. The fourth bedroom is a wonderful space for children, with a charming twin-over-queen bunk bed and an extra twin rollaway bed, smart TVs in each bunk, and a third larger TV for gaming. You will also find a queen blow-up mattress for extra sleeping space within the home.


Our well-equipped and modern kitchen offers plenty of space for entertaining and preparing a home-cooked meal after a day of adventure. Some helpful kitchen gadgets include a food processor, Crock-Pots, a French press, a coffee bean grinder, a Keurig machine, and a large wine/beverage fridge. Kick back and reminisce about the day in the family room, offering beautiful Gulf views along with a 65-inch smart TV for movie nights.

There will be no lack of fun to be had when everyone heads out to the beach for the day, as our guests will have access to ten beach chairs, two small umbrellas, a large ice chest with wheels, boogie boards, noodles, two double kayaks, four stand-up paddle-boards (two hard shell and two inflatable), multiple life vests for kids and adults, two beach carts with super-wide wheels, tons of sand toys, and beach games! And for indoor fun - lots of family board games, cards, poker chips, and puzzles!

WHAT’S NEARBY:
Located just west of the heart of downtown Destin, this home is situated in a quiet, kid-friendly, private neighborhood offering a peaceful stay while still being close to all of the action. Ride your bike(provided) to the water taxi dock and leave the car at home to tour all the action at HarborWalk Village by water taxi! Big Kahuna's Water & Adventure Park and The Track are both within 10 minutes from home. If you don't feel like making an elaborate meal for the whole group, it’s less than a 10-minute drive to Boshamps Seafood and Oyster House, AJ’s Seafood & Oyster Bar, or McGuire’s Irish Pub for some delectable cuisine! Not to mention, you can try your luck catching a big one while surf-casting from our private beach or go deep-sea fishing with a local skipper. Crab Island is accessible via the Crab Island Water Taxi.

INCLUDED IN YOUR STAY:
Free parking at the Harbor Walk Village (with arm band)
Kitchen stocked with essential cookware
Quality bath, kitchen, and laundry amenities
Iron or steamer
Bed linens
Washer/dryer
High speed WiFi

Destin Warbirds airshow followed by firework (Mondays & Thursday’s May - September)

listing_info.listing_name: Pet Friendly, Views, Private Boat Slip, Walk2Beach
listing_info.description:
Welcome to Harbor Oasis ~

The space
Our hidden hideaway ~ let us welcome you to our beautifully updated waterfront townhome on Holiday Isle. A “boaters paradise” with a 42' upland boat slip capable of supporting a boat/yacht. Admire the water views & bask in the sunshine on our spacious end unit sundeck overlooking the Holiday Isle Canals. Inhale the sea breeze & serenity while the boats slowly pass through the canal as they travel in & out of the harbor. Professionally managed locally by iTrip Vacations Destin & Miramar Beach.


Welcome to our charming, (3) bedroom, plus Florida Room/converted bunkroom within a two-level townhome! A perfect place to bring your boat or watercraft of choice for some well deserved rest & relaxation. Stroll .3 miles to the public beach or .5 miles to the private beach to enjoy the sugar-white sand between your toes & admire the crystal clear waters for a free dose of Vitamin D! If you get tired of building sandcastles, feel free to call the Destin Water Taxi for a pickup from the dock to take you across the harbor to enjoy a plethora of restaurants, shopping, water sports, & entertainment.


Upon arrival, the condo is a self check-in residence with a private entry code to assist in practicing social distancing & allowing you to enjoy your vacation without the stress of losing your keys.


When you arrive, enjoy the beautiful hardwood floors on the 2nd floor. Place your groceries in the updated kitchen blessed with cherry wood cabinets, new quartz counter tops & stainless steel appliances. The dining room table has seating for (4) with counter seating for (5). The open floor plan is inviting for entertaining, the kitchen overlooks the dining & living area with plantation shutters, crown molding, a sliding door to the upper level sundeck with dining seating for (4). The living room features a flat screen TV with a comfy sofa, loveseat & reclining chair where you can snuggle up, enjoy movies or play games.


The sliding glass doors off the living room fills the area with warmth & natural sunlight. The private sundeck on the upper level allows you to sit back at the dining table & observe all types of watercraft, SUP, kayaks, jet skis, boats, yachts cruise & port. The neighborhood is filled with local water lovers, many of them are boat captains, or work amongst the different water sports & they may share some fish stories. The exterior staircase leads to the fully covered lower patio to allow you to get out of the sun & enjoy a seat at the table for (2) to for a meal, snacks or libations. The BBQ gas grill is located on the patio with an outdoor shower to rinse off prior to coming inside.


The Master Bedroom is spacious & located on the 1st floor has clean lines, a king bed with comfy décor, 40” flat screen TV, ceiling fan, with a nice designer built in closet. The master includes an ensuite bathroom with a double vanity, glass-encased shower & commode. The Guest Master Bedroom is also located on the 1st floor, with a king bed, 40” flat screen TV, ceiling fan & closet. The ensuite bathroom has a glass-encased shower, single vanity & commode. For additional sleeping, we have converted the Florida Room on the 1st floor to a Bunk Room; it is located off the Master Bedroom with full bed on the bottom & a twin bed on the top. The room has a 32” Flat Screen TV & the full sized washer & dryer are located in the closet. The Guest Bedroom on the 2nd floor, has a queen bed, 32” flat screen TV, ceiling fan & nice closet. The bathroom is dedicated to the guest bedroom is adjacent to the bedroom with a single vanity, glass-encased shower & commode. This will also be used as a powder room for many of the guests on the 2nd floor.


If fishing is your game, Destin is known as “The World’s Luckiest Fishing Village” & claims to have the largest fishing vessel fleet in the state. If your looking for adventure, restaurants & shopping, Destin offers the Harborwalk Village, Destin Commons, Silver Sands Outlets & so much more.


We look forward to welcoming you to a piece of paradise along the Emerald Gulf Coast of the Florida Panhandle. At any time, if you have any questions, prior to booking, packing or during your stay, please do not hesitate to ask for we pride ourselves in providing you an exceptional customer experience.



AMENITIES AND PERKS:

• Pet Friendly ~ 2 maximum

• Boats Welcome

• Boat Slip ~ 42’ upland boat slip capable of supporting a boat/yacht. (Area dimensions: 42' L x 17' W with no height restrictions)

• Double your FUN ~ For larger groups traveling together please reach out for you can conveniently book our our adjoining townhome, Gulf Shore Drive #3 The Dock Inn, which also sleeps 10 people and shares the same dock.

• Xplorie “Free” Fun Pass - Daily Passes for Multiple Excursions

• Complimentary Beach Wagon & (4) Beach Chairs

• Destin Water Taxi ~ Call for Pick-up/Drop-off

• Great Snorkeling from the Public Beach ~ Plan Ahead & Bring Gear

• Bring Poles to Fish ~ Secure a Fishing License in Advance 888-FISH-FLORIDA

• Holiday Isle Private Beach Access @ Norriego Dr & Moreno Point

• Holiday Isle Public Beach Access @ Osteen Beach

• Designated Parking in Driveway for 6 vehicles (No trailers, RV’s or U-Hauls)

• Convenient to Shopping, Outlets, Groceries & Restaurants


SPECIAL NOTES:

• Age Requirements - You MUST be 25 years or older to book this property & must be staying in the condo for the duration of the reservation.

• Dogs are permitted in the residence but not on the beaches of Destin/Miramar. There are a plethora of parks in the area who welcome dogs.

• Cleaning - Our cleaning company is following & practicing the CDC Cleaning Guidelines

• “Xplorie Free Fun Pass” iTrip Vacations Destin invites our guests to enjoy (1) complimentary admission per day for one of the following activities (not available for stays over 27 days):

1. Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise

2. Baytowne Adventure Zone Airborne Adventures

3. Urban Air Adventure Par
We help make the most of your vacation by providing Free Admission to some of the area's top attractions each and every day! Create exciting memories, have more fun, and truly experience your destination!

listing_info.listing_name: Evening Views at Destin Pointe Resort
listing_info.description:
EVENING VIEWS AT DESTIN POINTE RESORT

The space
Evening Views is a four-bedroom, three-bathroom home that is a stunning retreat that offers breathtaking Gulf views and luxurious amenities. As you enter the home, you are greeted by a spacious living area beautifully decorated in shades of blues, creating a calm and relaxing atmosphere.
The living room features comfortable seating and a large TV, making it the perfect place to relax and unwind after exploring the local area. The adjacent dining area is perfect for hosting dinner parties and features a large table that can comfortably seat eight guests.
The fully equipped kitchen is a chef’s dream, with high-end appliances and ample counter space. The kitchen also features a breakfast bar to enjoy your morning coffee or a quick snack.
The four bedrooms are each beautifully decorated and offer a tranquil space to rest and rejuvenate. The master suite features a king bed with access to a spacious balcony. In the three guest bedrooms, one features a king bed, the other a queen, and the bunk room features two sets of twin-over-twin bunk beds.
The highlight of this luxury home is undoubtedly the private pool area. Surrounded by lush landscaping, the pool area offers plenty of space to relax and soak up the Florida sunshine. There are two lounge chairs, a dining table, and a barbecue grill, making it the perfect place to host outdoor gatherings.
The home features a pool table for indoor entertainment that will provide hours of fun for guests of all ages.
Overall, this luxury home offers the perfect combination of comfort and elegance, making it an ideal choice for a memorable vacation with family and friends.
*An additional pool heat fee of $300 is required to heat the pool and must be arranged before your stay.

**Evening Views is professionally managed by Destin Pointe Realty.

RESORT-STYLE AMENITIES

✦ Private beach access to the Emerald Coast
✦ Boat shuttle service to HarborWalk Village
✦ Three resort pools, including a gulf-front infinity-edge pool, heated pool, hot tub, and children’s splash pad

This two-story home accommodates up to 10 guests with 4 bedrooms and 4 baths. The layout is well-suited for families and groups, offering shared living areas balanced with private sleeping spaces. Each bedroom provides comfortable bedding and convenient access to a full bath or nearby bathroom, making it easy for everyone to settle in.

After time on the sand, the private outdoor pool creates a refreshing place to unwind. Seasonal pool heating is available by request for an additional fee. The BBQ grill adds a simple option for outdoor meals, while beach essentials are provided for your walks to the shore.

The state-of-the-art gourmet kitchen anchors the home, offering a functional and inviting space for preparing meals together. Perfect for

Destin and Surrounding areas

- Choctawhatchee Bay is a stunning coastal treasure located in the heart of Florida’s Emerald Coast, offering a serene escape into nature and endless opportunities for outdoor adventures. This expansive bay spans over 129 square miles, connecting to the Gulf of Mexico through the East Pass in Destin, and is surrounded by lush marshes, pine forests, and quaint waterfront communities.
- Destin HarborWalk Village is a vibrant waterfront destination in Destin, Florida, offering a mix of entertainment, shopping, dining, and adventure. Located along the scenic Destin Harbor, it serves as a hub for locals and visitors alike to experience the charm of the Emerald Coast.
- Henderson Beach State Park is a pristine natural retreat that showcases the beauty of the Emerald Coast. The park offers a serene escape for beachgoers, nature lovers, and outdoor enthusiasts.
Amenities include picnic pavilions, a playground, and clean restrooms with showers, making it a convenient spot for families. The park also offers camping facilities with RV hookups, allowing visitors to immerse themselves in nature overnight.
- Crab Island is an amazing, boat-accessible spot for socializing. Adventure seekers can enjoy dolphin cruises, jet ski tours, snorkeling, and sunset sails.
- Miramar Beach offers paddleboarding, jet skiing, and shopping at Grand Boulevard.
- Okaloosa Island and Fort Walton Beach feature white sand beaches, the Gulfarium Marine Adventure Park, and the Okaloosa Island Pier for fishing and dolphin watching.

Destin offers a variety of dining experiences, from fresh seafood at Dewey's Destin Seafood and Harbor Docks, Southern coastal cuisine at Boshamps, fun, casual atmospheres at The Back Porch and McGuire’s Irish Pub to upscale options like Marina Café and Seagar’s Prime Steaks & Seafood.

Feel free to reach out to anytime with questions or if you would like recommendations on fun activities in the area.
